**The problem it solves**

## The Problem WaterSafe Solves

Millions of people consume contaminated drinking water every day without realizing it because current water testing methods are delayed, expensive, and reactive. In many communities, contamination is only discovered after people start falling sick.

Traditional water monitoring systems mainly operate at municipal or laboratory level:
- Water samples are manually collected and tested
- Results can take **2–3 days**
- Household and community-level monitoring is almost nonexistent
- Sudden pipeline leaks, sewage mixing, or filtration failures often go undetected in real time

This creates a dangerous gap where schools, apartments, hostels, rural communities, and public water systems continue supplying unsafe water before authorities can respond.

---

## What People Can Use WaterSafe For

WaterSafe acts as a **real-time early-warning system for drinking water safety**.

It can be used in:
- Schools & colleges
- Apartment complexes
- Hostels & hospitals
- Rural water systems
- Community water tanks
- Public drinking water infrastructure

The system continuously monitors water quality using multiple sensors and Edge AI anomaly detection.

---

## How WaterSafe Makes Existing Systems Safer & Easier

### ✅ Real-Time Detection
Detects abnormal water conditions within seconds instead of waiting days for lab testing.

### ✅ Continuous Monitoring
Works 24/7 automatically without manual sample collection.

### ✅ Early Warning Alerts
Instantly alerts users through OLED/buzzer/SMS when contamination is suspected.

### ✅ Offline-First Operation
Works even without internet connectivity, making it suitable for rural and underserved areas.

### ✅ Affordable Deployment
Provides low-cost decentralized monitoring compared to expensive industrial systems.

### ✅ Reduced False Alarms
Uses a TinyML Autoencoder + Context Engine to distinguish real contamination from noise, bubbles, or sensor drift.

### ✅ Preventive Safety
Helps stop exposure before contamination spreads to hundreds of people in shared water systems.

---

## Core Impact

WaterSafe transforms water safety from:
> **Reactive testing after illness**
to
> **Proactive real-time monitoring before harm occurs**

> we did it

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/React.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Traditional digital learning tools like static PDF readers, text highlights, and standard quiz apps suffer from two major limitations which are information flattening and cognitive fragmentation.
Engage in Targeted Spatial Revision- Learners use a dedicated "Spatial Recall Mode" to physically navigate a 3D interface, locating and answering AI-generated flashcards directly tied to specific topics.
 Mnemo builds a living 3D knowledge universe. It replaces tedious, passive reading with automated, structured visualization and spatial retention analytics, making high-efficiency learning accessible to any student with a single click.

**Challenges we ran into**

When requesting concept extraction from the Gemini API, the model would occasionally include conversational preamble (e.g., "Here is your JSON knowledge graph:") or wrap the output in Markdown code blocks (⁠```json ... ```⁠). This completely broke standard ⁠JSON.parse()⁠ methods on the backend, resulting in application crashes and preventing the 3D graph from population

How We Got Over It-
We implemented a multi-layered defensive parsing pipeline inside ⁠/lib/gemini.ts⁠:  
1. System-Level Constraints- We explicitly engineered the prompt to demand ONLY valid JSON with no preamble.  
2. String Sanitization- We implemented a regex cleanup mechanism using ⁠.replace(/^```json/g, "").trim()⁠ to strip away potential Markdown formatting wrappers before parsing.

also 

In the initial builds, the AI was tasked with assigning 3D coordinates for extracted concepts. However, because LLMs lack inherent spatial awareness, Gemini generated clusters of nodes that sat directly on top of each other within a tight coordinate bounds (originally ⁠[-5, 5]⁠). In the frontend, this made the React Three Fiber knowledge universe look like a cluttered, unreadable ball of text.

How We Got Over It:
We moved spatial logic out of the AI's hands and engineered a dynamic mathematical dispersion layer directly inside our backend processing engine. We modified ⁠/lib/gemini.ts⁠ to assign coordinates programmatically by scaling a randomized distribution vector across a much wider ⁠[-8, 8]⁠ coordinate field

**Gen AI&ML**

It leverages LLM-driven unstructured data transformations and generative synthesis as its core system engines
it employs a specialized pipeline architecture where one generative task feeds directly into another

### AROGYA RAKSHAA
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/arogya-rakshaa-an-ai-health-care-eco-system-4d26) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ifthekharahmad69-ship-it/AROGYA-RAKSHAA-AI.git) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zobrYQrJoOXVUP2SyDB9sRDebdryg6q0/view?usp=drivesdk) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackPrix%20Season%203-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackprix-2026.devfolio.co)

> AN AI DRIVEN HEALTHCARE ECO SYSTEM WITH AGENTIC AI

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSOC](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSOC-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Accessing reliable, timely, and understandable healthcare in a country with over 1.4 billion people and immense linguistic diversity is a massive challenge. Millions face barriers ranging from language constraints and fragmented medical records to delayed emergency responses and lack of actionable health guidance. 
**AROGYA RAKSHAA** solves these critical pain points by providing a unified, AI-driven healthcare ecosystem designed for accessibility and speed at scale.
### 1. Breaking the Language Barrier
Most medical information is available only in English, leaving a vast majority of the population underserved. Arogya Raksha solves this by providing **native support for 8 Indian languages** (including Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi, Bengali, etc.), ensuring users can check symptoms, interact with AI doctors, and navigate health services in the language they understand best.
### 2. Fragmented Emergency Response & Crisis Management
During emergencies, every second counts, but fragmented communication often causes fatal delays. 
* Our **Crisis Command Center** and **Ambulance Responder App** provide an end-to-end emergency pipeline. 
* The **Emergency ID & QR Code** system automatically transmits a patient's complete medical profile and vital history to hospitals during SOS situations, ensuring doctors are prepared before the patient even arrives.
### 3. Lack of Immediate Medical Guidance
Instead of relying on inaccurate internet searches, users have access to our **AI Doctor & Symptom Checker**. Powered by Groq and advanced LLMs (Llama 3.3 70B & Vision models), it analyzes symptoms intelligently, reads medical documents/images, and provides preliminary guidance—reducing panic and directing users to appropriate care.
### 4. Difficulty in Finding Resources
Locating nearby facilities or understanding medications can be confusing. The platform aggregates a massive database of over **250,000 medicines** and **200,000 hospitals**. Users can:
* Use the **Medicine Intelligence** module to understand drug details, side effects, and alternatives.
* Use the **Hospital Discovery & Map** features for real-time geolocation of nearby medical facilities.
By combining an intelligent AI agent (MediBot), real-time WebSockets, and a robust data layer, **AROGYA RAKSHAA** democratizes healthcare access, turning a fragmented system into a cohesive, user-centric lifeline.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building a production-grade healthcare ecosystem with 20+ pages, 17 API routes, and 10+ AI features in just 24 hours was incredibly demanding. Here are the major challenges we overcame:
### 1. Scaling the Data Layer
One of our biggest hurdles was handling massive datasets efficiently. We seeded over **250,000 medicines** and **200,000 hospital records**. Ensuring lightning-fast search and retrieval for the Hospital Discovery and Medicine Intelligence modules required rigorous database optimization in Supabase (PostgreSQL) and implementing Redis caching to prevent API timeouts.
### 2. Ensuring AI Medical Accuracy & Safety
Using LLMs in healthcare is risky due to hallucinations. Integrating Groq (Llama 3.3 70B & Llama 4 Scout Vision) for the **AI Doctor & Symptom Checker** required extensive prompt engineering and context boundary setting. We had to ensure the AI explicitly clarified it was an assistant (not a replacement for doctors) while still providing highly accurate, actionable symptom analysis and clinical pathways.
### 3. Implementing True Multilingual Support
To make the app accessible to 1.4 billion people, we implemented support for **8 Indian regional languages**. Dynamically translating medical terminology accurately without losing the nuance of symptoms, and maintaining UI consistency across varying text lengths, was a significant technical and design challenge.
### 4. Real-time Emergency Infrastructure
The **Crisis Command Center** and **Ambulance Responder App** required rock-solid real-time communication. Implementing Socket.io for live SOS alerts, location tracking via Leaflet maps, and WebRTC for video consultations simultaneously led to complex state management issues on the frontend that we had to meticulously debug.
### 5. Multi-Service Orchestration
Integrating a myriad of third-party services—Clerk (Auth), Supabase (DB), Redis (Caching), Cloudinary (Media), Razorpay (Payments), Firebase (Push Notifications), and Resend (Emails)—into a cohesive flow without bottlenecking the Next.js frontend or Express backend required careful architectural planning and robust error handling.

**Sarvam.ai**

### Advanced Integration of Sarvam AI in AROGYA RAKSHAA
To make AROGYA RAKSHAA truly accessible to 1.4 billion people—especially in rural areas with low English literacy—we didn't just stop at a web UI. We deeply integrated **Sarvam AI's advanced Indic language models** to create a seamless, voice-first, multilingual healthcare ecosystem. 
We utilized two primary Sarvam AI models at the core of our application:
#### 1. Context-Aware Medical Translation (Mayura:v1)
Standard translation APIs often fail at complex medical terminology, potentially causing dangerous misunderstandings. We integrated Sarvam's `mayura:v1` model to power our dynamic translation engine. 
* **How we used it:** When our Groq/Llama-based AI Doctor generates complex clinical pathways, symptom analysis, or medicine instructions in English, we pipe that output through the Sarvam Translate API.
* **The Result:** We deliver contextually accurate medical translations in **8 Indian languages** (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali, Bhojpuri, and English), ensuring users read medical advice in their native dialects.
#### 2. Native-Sounding Healthcare Voice Assistant (Bulbul:v1)
To help visually impaired users, elderly patients, or users who prefer listening over reading, we built a Text-to-Speech (TTS) engine using Sarvam's `bulbul:v1` model.
* **How we used it:** We dynamically convert the translated medical text (generated via Mayura) into high-fidelity audio streams. We specifically configured the `meera` speaker profile, optimized the sample rate (22050Hz), and tuned loudness/pace parameters for clear, reassuring medical guidance.
* **The Result:** AROGYA RAKSHAA literally "speaks" to the user. Whether it is reading out SOS crisis instructions or explaining the side effects of a medicine, the Sarvam TTS integration makes our platform highly inclusive and empathetic.
**Summary of Impact:** By chaining Llama 3.3 for reasoning, Sarvam `mayura:v1` for translation, and Sarvam `bulbul:v1` for voice, we built a fully autonomous, voice-enabled, vernacular healthcare assistant that can hold intelligent medical conversations in local Indian languages.
3:52 PM

**Gen AI&ML**

### How AROGYA RAKSHAA fits the Gen AI & ML Track

AROGYA RAKSHAA is not just a healthcare dashboard; its core value proposition is entirely driven by advanced Generative AI and Machine Learning models. We have deeply integrated Gen AI to transform raw medical data into actionable, accessible, and personalized healthcare intelligence. 

Here is how our project pushes the boundaries of Gen AI & ML:

#### 1. Agentic AI Ecosystem (MediBot)
Instead of a simple RAG chatbot, we built a fully autonomous **Tool-Calling AI Agent (MediBot)** powered by **Llama 3.3 70B** (via Groq). MediBot doesn't just answer questions; it acts on behalf of the user. It can autonomously trigger 8 different internal tools to:
* Search the 250k+ medicine database.
* Book hospital appointments.
* Analyze medical images.
* Provide real-time navigation guidance to the nearest health facilities.

#### 2. Multi-Modal Vision AI for Diagnostics
We integrated **Llama 4 Scout Vision** to give our AI "eyes." Users can upload complex medical documents, prescription slips, or images of physical symptoms. The Vision ML model parses the visual data, extracts the medical context, and translates it into plain language, effectively acting as an instant, preliminary radiologist/pharmacist.

#### 3. AI-Driven Clinical Pathways & Symptom Checking
Our **AI Doctor Symptom Checker** utilizes generative models to conduct dynamic triage. By processing natural language descriptions of user symptoms, the LLM maps them against medical literature to generate probability-based differential diagnoses. It then generates personalized, step-by-step clinical pathways (e.g., "Take this immediate action," "Consult a specialist within 24 hours").

#### 4. Real-Time Multilingual NLP
To serve 1.4 billion people, we utilized Natural Language Processing (NLP) to break language barriers. Generative AI dynamically translates complex medical jargon into highly accurate, localized dialects across **8 Indian languages** (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi, etc.), ensuring AI-driven medical intelligence is not restricted to English speakers.

#### Summary for Judges:
AROGYA RAKSHAA utilizes **Large Language Models for reasoning (Llama 3.3), Vision Models for perception (Llama 4 Scout), and Agentic frameworks for execution**. We moved beyond basic GenAI wrappers to build a deterministic, safe, and robust AI orchestration layer tailored specifically for critical healthcare scenarios.

**The problem it solves**

SportsIQ is an AI-powered platform that helps players learn, coaches train, umpires make better decisions, and organizers manage sports competitions efficiently. 

Our platform helps players improve their skills, assists officials in making fair decisions, provides coaches with performance insights. We are starting with cricket and building a solution that can be expanded to multiple sports in the future.

**Challenges we ran into**

. Designing a Unified Sports Platform

The biggest challenge was integrating multiple modules—AI Learning, AI Referee, AI Coach, Match Highlights, and Analytics—into a single platform while maintaining a simple and intuitive user experience.

2. AI-Based Rule Detection

Creating an AI Referee system capable of analyzing video footage and identifying fouls, offsides, no-balls, wides, and other rule violations required studying sport-specific rules and designing a scalable AI workflow.

3. Multi-Sport Scalability

Different sports have different rules, movements, and evaluation criteria. Designing an architecture that can support multiple sports without rebuilding the system from scratch was a significant challenge.

4. Video Processing and Analysis

Sports videos are large and computationally expensive to process. Managing video uploads, frame extraction, event detection, and efficient storage while maintaining acceptable performance was challenging.

5. Real-Time Feedback Generation

The AI Coach feature needed to provide actionable feedback rather than generic suggestions. Designing a system that converts match events into understandable coaching insights was complex.

6. Learning Path Personalization

Building personalized learning recommendations for players of different skill levels required designing flexible content categorization and recommendation mechanisms.

**Gemini**

SportsIQ fits into the Generative AI and Machine Learning track because AI is the core technology powering the platform rather than being an additional feature. The project uses Machine Learning and Computer Vision to analyze sports videos, detect player movements, identify match events, and assist in rule violation detection through the AI Referee system. These models help process visual data and generate objective insights from match footage. Generative AI is integrated using Google's Gemini model, which acts as the intelligence layer of the platform. Gemini analyzes the outputs generated by the ML systems and transforms them into personalized coaching feedback, training recommendations, performance reports, and interactive learning assistance. For example, after a match analysis, Gemini can explain a player's strengths and weaknesses in natural language, suggest specific drills for improvement, answer sports-related questions, and create customized learning paths based on the athlete's skill level. By combining Machine Learning for video understanding and Gemini for human-like reasoning, explanation, and content generation, SportsIQ delivers an intelligent sports ecosystem that provides automated officiating, performance analysis, and personalized coaching, making professional sports guidance accessible to every athlete.

**Gen AI&ML**

SportsIQ fits into the Generative AI and Machine Learning track because AI is the core technology driving the platform's functionality. The project uses Machine Learning and Computer Vision techniques to analyze sports videos, detect player actions, identify rule violations, and generate performance insights. The AI Referee system can automatically review match footage and assist in making objective decisions, reducing human error in officiating. Additionally, SportsIQ leverages Generative AI through its AI Coach feature, which transforms raw performance data into personalized coaching feedback, training recommendations, and learning guidance. Instead of simply displaying statistics, the platform generates human-like explanations and actionable suggestions tailored to each athlete's performance. By combining video analysis, intelligent decision-making, personalized learning, and AI-generated coaching support, SportsIQ creates a complete sports intelligence ecosystem, making professional-level coaching and match analysis accessible to athletes at all levels.

**The problem it solves**

AEGIS AI is an intelligent AI Security Gateway that acts as a protective firewall between users and AI systems. It continuously analyzes prompts, URLs, files, and IP addresses to detect potential threats before they reach the AI model. Using AI-driven threat detection, risk scoring, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and real-time security recommendations, AEGIS AI helps organizations prevent data leakage, block malicious activities, and ensure safe AI adoption.
Impact
By providing real-time threat detection and automated security analysis, AEGIS AI enables organizations to confidently deploy AI technologies while maintaining strong cybersecurity standards, reducing operational risk, and protecting sensitive data.
One-Line Closing
"AEGIS AI secures AI before AI processes the request." 🛡️🤖

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges we faced during development was integrating multiple APIs and managing API keys securely across the application. During testing, we encountered authentication failures, invalid key errors, and rate-limit issues, which caused disruptions in the threat analysis workflow. Another major hurdle was establishing reliable communication between the frontend and backend, where incorrect endpoint configurations and data handling inconsistencies led to failed requests and delayed responses.

To overcome these issues, we implemented proper environment variable management for API keys, improved error handling and validation mechanisms, and thoroughly tested API integrations using debugging tools. On the backend side, we standardized request/response formats, optimized API routing, and performed extensive end-to-end testing to ensure smooth communication between all components. These improvements significantly increased the stability, security, and reliability of the platform.

**Sarvam.ai**

I use Sarwan AI by submitting a prompt, URL, file, or IP address through the dashboard. The platform automatically analyzes the input for security threats, generates a risk score, maps findings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, and provides mitigation recommendations. This helps me detect and prevent cyber threats before they reach the AI system.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/resqmesh-a277) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/jeevan1276/ResQMesh) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://youtube.com/shorts/flxqVksULVs?si=rWtf7fz6og_DLnRl) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackPrix%20Season%203-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackprix-2026.devfolio.co)

> RM

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

ResQMesh is an offline-first disaster communication and rescue coordination system designed for situations where cellular networks and internet connectivity are unavailable due to natural disasters such as floods, earthquakes, or cyclones. It enables victims to propagate emergency messages through a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) mesh network, allowing requests for help to travel across nearby devices without relying on communication infrastructure. Once any device regains internet access, the collected messages are synchronized to the backend, where Gemini AI automatically classifies and prioritizes incidents based on severity and category. These incidents are then displayed on a Rescue Coordination Dashboard that provides rescue teams with real-time situational awareness through interactive maps, severity-based prioritization, incident tracking, and resolution workflows, helping responders identify and assist the most critical cases faster and more efficiently.

**Challenges we ran into**

Offline Communication Constraints: Establishing reliable communication without internet connectivity required designing a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) mesh-based approach where messages could propagate across nearby devices.

Message Synchronization: Ensuring that messages generated offline were not lost and could be synchronized correctly once a device regained internet access.

Incident Prioritization: Raw emergency messages vary significantly in format and urgency, making it challenging to automatically identify critical situations and prioritize rescue efforts.

Real-Time Visualization: Integrating classified incidents with an interactive map and maintaining accurate location-based incident tracking.

Database Integration: Transitioning from hardcoded data to persistent MongoDB storage while supporting incident updates and resolution workflows.

Scalability Considerations: Designing a system that works for the prototype stage while remaining extensible to future technologies such as LoRa gateways, drone relays, and cloud deployment

**Gemini**

Disaster triage requires near-instant responses. The gemini-2.5-flash model is Google's most speed-optimized model, processing and classifying incoming emergency distress messages in under a second.

**MongoDB**

Offline-First Synchronization (Atlas Device Sync)
The core architecture of ResQMesh relies on local gateway servers storing data fully offline and automatically uploading it when internet breakout occurs. MongoDB Atlas provides native, out-of-the-box syncing mechanisms. Records can be flagged as synced: false locally, and MongoDB Atlas handles merging the changes to the cloud repository seamlessly when a connection is established.

2. Flexible Document Schema (BSON / JSON)
Disaster response data is inherently unstructured and variable:

One message might contain specific GPS coordinate floats.
Another might be a text-only distress note.
A third might be a list of required supplies (food, water, blankets). MongoDB’s document-based model allows us to store these varying payloads within a single incidents collection without the strict column limitations of relational SQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL).

**Open Innovation**

ResQMesh addresses a real-world societal challenge that spans multiple domains, including disaster management, emergency response, communication systems, artificial intelligence, and public safety. Rather than solving a problem specific to a single industry, it provides a broadly applicable platform that can be adapted for various disaster scenarios and emergency situations. The project combines innovative use of BLE mesh networking, AI-powered incident prioritization, and rescue coordination to create a resilient communication system for environments where traditional infrastructure fails. Its interdisciplinary nature and potential for large-scale social impact make it well-suited for the Open Innovation category.

### Aegis
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/aegis-f0f0) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Twilightz12/Aegis) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtube.com/shorts/zYVJb-m26Us?si=OgwA5Ld37zmE4tn9) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackPrix%20Season%203-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackprix-2026.devfolio.co)

> Beyond The Visible

![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![Dart](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dart-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firestore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firestore-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase Cloud Messaging](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase%20Cloud%20Messaging-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Aegis solves one of the biggest flaws in modern emergency systems: most safety apps only work when the victim can openly use their phone. In situations like kidnapping, stalking, trafficking, assault, domestic violence, accidents, or disasters, victims often cannot unlock a phone, open an SOS app, or visibly ask for help without increasing danger.

Existing solutions also rely heavily on internet connectivity and usually stop at sending a single alert. They rarely preserve evidence, maintain live tracking, adapt to low battery conditions, or continue trying alternative communication methods when networks fail.

Aegis addresses this by acting as a stealth-first survivability ecosystem disguised as a normal music app. It can be activated covertly through secret phrases, hidden taps, or patterns without revealing any visible SOS activity. Once triggered, it silently captures evidence, tracks movement, assesses threat severity, and continuously attempts to reach help through multiple fallback channels including internet, SMS, mesh networking, LoRa, ultrasonic communication, satellite relay, and offline store-and-forward systems.

By combining stealth, resilience, evidence preservation, multilingual accessibility, and communication redundancy, Aegis increases the chances of rescue even in the most hostile or disconnected environments.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was building a system that stays completely stealthy while still running critical emergency features in the background. Android aggressively restricts background microphone access, GPS updates, and battery usage, so keeping voice-trigger detection active without making the app look suspicious required careful optimization and permission handling.

Another major hurdle was reliability during poor connectivity. Most emergency systems fail when internet access disappears, so we had to design a fallback communication architecture that could queue distress packets offline, retry automatically, and switch between channels like Firebase and SMS without losing data.

We also faced challenges balancing battery life with live tracking. Continuous GPS and audio recording drained power quickly, especially during long emergencies. To solve this, we implemented an adaptive “Ultra Survival Mode” that reduces update frequency, compresses data, and prioritizes low-cost communication methods when battery levels drop.

Designing the decoy interface was another unique challenge. The app needed to behave convincingly like a real music application while secretly supporting covert triggers and emergency workflows underneath. We solved this by separating the visible UI from the hidden emergency engine running in the background.

Finally, implementing multilingual voice activation across Indian languages introduced speech-recognition accuracy issues due to accents, pronunciation differences, and background noise. We improved reliability by requiring users to train the system with their own spoken trigger phrase during setup instead of relying only on generic recognition models.

**Open Innovation**

Aegis fits the Open Innovation track because it combines ideas from cybersecurity, emergency response, communication systems, IoT, stealth UX design, and disaster-resilient networking into a single unified safety ecosystem. Instead of solving only one part of the problem, Aegis integrates covert activation, multilingual accessibility, evidence preservation, live tracking, offline recovery, and multi-channel communication redundancy into one platform.

The project also explores innovative fallback communication methods such as mesh networking, LoRa, ultrasonic transmission, DTN, and satellite relay concepts to ensure distress signals can survive even when traditional infrastructure fails. By disguising itself as a normal music app and focusing on survivability in real-world hostile conditions, Aegis rethinks how emergency systems should operate when victims cannot safely ask for help.

Its modular architecture allows future expansion into wearables, official emergency-service integration, and community-based rescue networks, making it a scalable and socially impactful innovation for public safety.

### HiveNet

> The power of many minds working as One

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

MEs often manage finance, inventory, HR, sales, and compliance data across multiple systems, spreadsheets, and documents. This fragmented information makes it difficult to obtain timely insights, automate routine processes, and make informed business decisions.

As a result, organizations face challenges such as:

Limited visibility into financial performance and cash flow
Inefficient inventory and supply chain management
Time-consuming HR operations and employee management
Poor sales forecasting and customer insight generation
Manual compliance tracking and audit preparation
Delayed decision-making due to scattered data

These issues lead to reduced efficiency, increased operational costs, compliance risks, and slower business growth.

Solution: HiveNet

HiveNet is an AI-powered business management platform that addresses these challenges through specialized intelligent agents:

FinBot – Financial analysis, expense tracking, and forecasting
LogBot – Inventory monitoring and supply chain optimization
HRBot – Workforce management and HR process automation
SalesBot – Revenue forecasting and sales intelligence
AuditBot – Compliance monitoring and audit support

By centralizing business data and providing AI-driven insights, HiveNet helps organizations automate operations, improve decision-making, enhance compliance, and drive overall business efficiency.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Relational Database Design

Designing a unified database structure was challenging because each bot (Finance, HR, Logistics, Sales, and Audit) required different types of data while still needing to share information across modules. Ensuring data consistency, normalization, and efficient relationships between entities required careful schema planning.

2. RAG Pipeline Implementation

Building the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline involved challenges in document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, vector storage, and retrieval accuracy. Ensuring that responses were based on relevant company documents while minimizing irrelevant context required extensive tuning.

3. Maintaining Common Context Across Bots

Since all bots operate within the same business ecosystem, establishing a shared organizational context was essential. The challenge was enabling each bot to access relevant cross-functional information without creating data duplication or context conflicts.

4. Developing the ISO/Audit Bot

The Audit Bot required interpreting complex ISO standards and compliance documents. Mapping organizational data and uploaded documents against compliance requirements while generating meaningful audit insights and non-conformity detection posed a significant challenge.

5. Cross-Module Integration

Integrating Finance, HR, Logistics, Sales, and Audit functionalities into a single platform while maintaining scalability, performance, and a consistent user experience required careful system architecture and API design.

6. Ensuring Response Accuracy

Providing reliable business insights from both structured database records and unstructured documents was challenging. Considerable effort was spent on improving retrieval quality, prompt engineering, and validation mechanisms to reduce inaccurate responses.

**Gemini**

1. Compliance Document Analysis

Users upload policies, SOPs, audit reports, process documents, or compliance records. Gemini analyzes the content and extracts relevant information related to compliance requirements.

2. ISO Requirement Mapping

AuditBot compares the uploaded organizational documents with ISO clauses and requirements. Gemini identifies whether sufficient evidence exists for each requirement and highlights potential gaps.

Example:

ISO clause requires documented risk management procedures.
Gemini reviews uploaded documents.
AuditBot reports whether evidence is present, partially present, or missing.
3. Gap and Non-Conformity Detection

Gemini analyzes documents to identify:

Missing documentation
Incomplete procedures
Non-conformities
Areas requiring corrective action

This significantly reduces the manual effort normally required during internal audits.

4. Audit Question Answering

Using the RAG pipeline, AuditBot retrieves relevant compliance documents and provides context to Gemini. Gemini then generates accurate responses to audit-related questions.

Example Queries:

"Which ISO 9001 clauses are currently not satisfied?"
"Show evidence for employee training compliance."
"What corrective actions are pending?"
5. Audit Report Generation

Based on the analysis results, Gemini generates:

Compliance summaries
Non-conformity reports
Audit observations
Recommended corrective actions
Technical Flow
User uploads compliance documents.
Documents are processed and stored in the RAG knowledge base.
Relevant sections are retrieved using semantic search.
Retrieved context is sent to Gemini.
Gemini analyzes the evidence against ISO requirements.
AuditBot presents compliance status, gaps, and recommendations.

**Gen AI&ML**

HiveNet combines both Generative AI (GenAI) and Machine Learning (ML) to create an intelligent business management platform.

Generative AI Components

HiveNet uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to:

Provide natural language interaction through FinBot, LogBot, HRBot, SalesBot, and AuditBot.
Answer business-related questions conversationally.
Summarize reports, documents, and compliance records.
Generate insights and recommendations from organizational data.
Power the RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system to answer questions using company-specific documents and policies.

Example:
A user can ask, "What is my highest-selling product?" or "Which ISO clauses are not satisfied?" and receive a human-like, context-aware response.

Machine Learning Components

HiveNet leverages ML models to analyze historical business data and make predictions.

Prophet → Sales and financial forecasting
LightGBM → Revenue prediction, demand forecasting, and business analytics
OCR Models → Extract structured information from invoices, receipts, and business documents
Embedding Models → Convert documents into vector representations for semantic search in the RAG pipeline

Example:
SalesBot can forecast future revenue trends, while LogBot can predict inventory demand and recommend reorder quantities.

Why HiveNet is a GenAI + ML Solution

Traditional business dashboards only display historical data. HiveNet goes beyond analytics by:

Predicting future outcomes using Machine Learning.
Understanding and generating human language using Generative AI.
Retrieving knowledge from company documents using RAG.
Providing actionable recommendations instead of just raw data.

> Student Hub - Your campus, connected by AI

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Student Hub is a free campus platform where students can share study notes and past papers, discover internships and hackathons, form project teams, chat with classmates, RSVP to events, bookmark important posts, and join community discussions — all from one account instead of juggling WhatsApp groups, Google Drive links, and social media. It makes everyday tasks easier by letting you search resources by course code, see deadlines in one place, manage projects and messages together, install the app on your phone as a PWA, and access everything on any device with a single dashboard overview. It also makes collaboration safer through verified email signup, role-based access control, protected private pages, secure file sharing with optional access codes and expiry dates, and admin oversight — so sharing and connecting on campus is faster, more organized, and more accountable than scattered chat-based workflows.

**Challenges we ran into**

The biggest hurdle was running Firebase Auth alongside Supabase — login lived in Firebase, but profiles, resources, and RLS policies expected Supabase-style UUIDs, so users logged in but data often failed to link. I fixed that with a deterministic UUID mapper (getDeterministicUuid) so every Firebase UID always maps to the same database ID, and I cleared stale Supabase session tokens on app load to stop ghost login states. Messaging was another pain point: without access to auth.users, I couldn’t reliably look users up by email from the client, so I had to work around it via the profiles table and an admin Edge Function for secure user listing. Community discussions needed live updates, so I added Firebase Realtime Database on top of Supabase, which meant managing two backends. Smaller but annoying bugs included password reset URLs arriving in different formats (hash vs query params), PWA install prompts firing too aggressively on SPA routes (fixed with delayed prompts + localStorage dismiss), and landing-page scroll animations breaking on resize until I recalculated layout after the DOM finished painting.

**Sarvam.ai**

StudentHub leverages Sarvam AI’s advanced voice and speech APIs to introduce an intuitive audio interface. This allows students to interact with the platform hands-free—such as asking for project updates, dictating study notes, or navigating features using natural voice commands in their native dialects, significantly boosting the app's accessibility."

**Open Innovation**

We chose the Open Innovation track because StudentHub is designed to be a versatile, general-purpose tool for the student community rather than a niche product. By building a platform that allows users to can post internships and hackathons. we are fostering a culture of open collaboration and creative problem-solving among peers. This project demonstrates innovation by reimagining how students use this project.

> Terminating your Office Tools

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

## The Problem OFFICE-NATOR Solves

---

Meet **Ramesh**. He runs a small textile business in Surat. Every evening he opens Excel to update his inventory — quantities, prices, supplier names. He knows what he wants to do. He just doesn't always know *how* to do it in Excel.

He wants to make the header row bold. He goes to Format → Cells → Font → Bold. Or was it the toolbar? He can't remember. It takes 4 clicks and 30 seconds. He does this every single day.

He wants to freeze the top row so it stays visible while he scrolls. He Googles it. Again. For the third time this month.

**Ramesh is not alone.** He represents hundreds of millions of people across India — shopkeepers, teachers, accountants, government clerks, small business owners — who use Excel daily but never feel fully in control of it.

---

### What OFFICE-NATOR actually changes

**For someone like Ramesh**, instead of hunting through menus:

> *"Pehli row freeze karo"* → done in 1 second.
> *"Header ko bold aur 14 size karo"* → done in 2 seconds.
> *"Column ki width autofit karo"* → done instantly.

He never has to Google a shortcut again. He never has to switch between Hindi thought and English command. He just speaks, like he would to a colleague sitting next to him.

---

### Real tasks it makes faster

**Daily data entry work**
Instead of manually formatting each row after entry, just say *"is row ko currency format mein dikhao"* or *"percentage format lagao"* — the entire formatting pipeline executes in under 2 seconds.

**Report preparation**
Making a monthly report look professional used to mean 20 minutes of formatting — borders, bold headers, alignment, font size. Now: *"header format karo"*, *"borders sab taraf lagao"*, *"center align karo"* — done in under a minute, hands-free.

**Data cleanup**
*"Duplicate rows hatao"*, *"sort A se Z karo"*, *"filter lagao"* — common data hygiene tasks that non-power users typically skip because they don't know where the button is. Now they're one sentence away.

**Avoiding mistakes**
Before OFFICE-NATOR, deleting a row or clearing a range was one accidental click. Now any destructive action requires you to **say "haan" out loud** to confirm. That single confirmation step prevents the most common Excel disaster — accidentally wiping data.

**Working with both hands occupied**
Accountants, data entry operators, and warehouse managers often need to look at physical documents while updating Excel. OFFICE-NATOR lets you keep your eyes on the paper and your voice on the task.

---

### Who specifically benefits

| Person | Their problem | How it helps |
|---|---|---|
| Small business owner | Knows Hindi, struggles with Excel menus | Speaks commands naturally, no English needed |
| Data entry clerk | Repetitive formatting 6 hours a day | Voice shortcuts cut formatting time by 80% |
| Government worker | Uses Excel but never learned shortcuts | 129 operations available by voice |
| Teacher preparing marks sheets | Not tech-savvy, avoids complex features | Simple voice → complex operations |
| Finance professional | Fast-paced work, hands busy | Executes shortcuts without touching keyboard |
| Student learning Excel | Doesn't know where features are hidden | Voice discovers and executes features |

---

### The broader point

**Excel has been around for 40 years. Its power users are a tiny minority.** Most people use 5% of what it can do — not because they don't need the other 95%, but because they never learned it, and the interface doesn't help them find it.

OFFICE-NATOR doesn't just make Excel faster for experts. It makes the full power of Excel accessible to people who never had access to it before — in their own language, in their own words, on their own terms.

That's not a productivity tool. That's a genuinely new kind of access.

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges We Ran Into

---

### 1. The LLM kept inventing wrong keyboard shortcuts

This was the first wall we hit and it nearly killed the project.

We started by asking the LLM to generate the keyboard steps for each Excel operation directly. It would confidently return things like `["alt", "h", "w"]` pressed simultaneously for wrap text — which does absolutely nothing in Excel. Or it would return `["ctrl", "shift", "w"]` which doesn't even exist. Every time we tested a new command, something would work for 3 tries and then silently fail on the 4th with a slightly different phrasing.

**The fix:** We stopped asking the LLM to think about keyboard shortcuts at all. We hand-coded 129 Excel operations as deterministic Python functions — every ribbon sequence, every hotkey, every multi-step dialog navigation — verified against real Excel. The LLM's only job now is to read the sentence and say *"that's a `wrap_text`"* or *"that's a `set_font_size` with size=16"*. The actual steps come from the library, not from the model. The LLM classifies. The code executes.

This one architectural change took us from ~40% reliability to near 100%.

---

### 2. Alt+H → W was being pressed simultaneously, not sequentially

Even after building the action library, wrap text still wasn't working. We'd press Alt+H to open the Home ribbon tab, then press W — but nothing happened.

The issue: PyAutoGUI's `hotkey()` function presses all keys *at the same time*. Excel's ribbon navigation requires pressing Alt+H, *releasing it*, then pressing W separately. Pressing Alt+H+W simultaneously is a different shortcut entirely (or nothing at all).

We spent two hours debugging this before we realized it. The visual feedback in Excel was zero — it just silently ignored the input.

**The fix:** We created a new `ribbon` action type in the actuator that presses each key one at a time with an 80ms gap between them. `hotkey` still does simultaneous presses (for Ctrl+B, Ctrl+S etc.), but anything involving ribbon navigation uses the sequential `ribbon` action. Once we split these two action types, everything started working.

---

### 3. The Gemini API key worked, then stopped, then worked again

We spent a full hour thinking our code was broken when actually the Gemini free tier had hit its quota. The API was returning `429` with `limit: 0` — meaning the quota was exhausted at the account level, not per-minute.

The confusing part: we created fresh API keys on new Google accounts and they *also* returned `limit: 0` instantly. Turns out new Google accounts need to visit AI Studio and accept terms of service before the free quota is allocated. The key exists but the quota doesn't until you activate it.

We hit this same wall three times with three different keys before figuring out the pattern.

**The fix:** We switched Groq (Llama 3.3 70B) as the primary provider and kept Gemini as fallback. Groq gives 14,400 free requests per day and responds in under a second. We also built a live provider switcher in the frontend so users can swap between Groq, Gemini, OpenAI, or any custom endpoint without restarting anything. No more single point of failure on one API key.

---

### 4. MongoDB Atlas couldn't connect — but only in Node.js

We built a full auth system with MongoDB Atlas — registration, login, JWT cookies, the works. Tested the connection string in PowerShell DNS: resolved fine. Opened MongoDB Compass: connected fine.

But when Next.js tried to connect, it threw `querySrv ECONNREFUSED _mongodb._tcp.cluster0.vjz9xp3.mongodb.net` every single time.

After an hour of debugging we found the root cause: Node.js on Windows resolves DNS through `127.0.0.1` (the loopback) rather than the system DNS. PowerShell uses Windows DNS which works. Node.js uses a different resolver that was returning connection refused on the SRV record lookup that MongoDB Atlas requires for `+srv` connection strings.

The fix was one line: `dns.setServers(['8.8.8.8', '8.8.4.4'])` at the top of the MongoDB client file, before any connection attempt. This forces Node.js to use Google's public DNS instead of the loopback, and the SRV record resolves immediately.

We documented this in `SETUP_GUIDE.md` because it will catch anyone else who tries to run this on Windows.

---

### 5. The backend can't be deployed — at all

We had the frontend looking great, deployed to Vercel, and then realized: the Python backend literally cannot run in any cloud container.

PyAudio needs a microphone. PyAutoGUI needs a desktop to send keyboard events to. edge-tts needs speakers to play audio through. Vercel, Railway, Render — they're all headless Linux containers. No microphone, no display, no desktop. You can't fake these.

This meant our "deploy and demo" plan fell apart 2 hours before submission prep.

**The fix:** We kept the backend local and used ngrok to expose `localhost:8000` as a public HTTPS URL. The Vercel frontend connects to the ngrok URL via WebSocket. The backend runs on the lap

**Gen AI&ML**

**OFFICE-NATOR** is a multi-model Generative AI pipeline where every stage uses a different AI/ML model working in sequence to translate human intent into machine action.

**The Full GenAI/ML Stack**

- Stage 1 — Speech Understanding (ML) Silero VAD, a lightweight neural network model, continuously analyzes the microphone audio stream in real time to detect when the user starts and stops speaking. This is a classic ML inference task running locally on CPU — no cloud, no API call, pure model inference at 16kHz.

- Stage 2 — Multilingual Speech-to-Text + Translation (GenAI) Sarvam AI's saaras:v3 model transcribes Hindi and Marathi speech and simultaneously translates it to English in a single forward pass. This is a sequence-to-sequence generative model — the same architecture family as Whisper and mT5 — purpose-trained on Indic languages, which no general-purpose STT model handles well.

- Stage 3 — Intent Classification (Large Language Model / GenAI) Groq's Llama 3.3 70B — a 70-billion parameter autoregressive language model — reads the translated English command and generates a structured JSON response identifying which of 129 possible Excel actions the user wants, plus any parameters (font size, column width, cell reference etc.). This is pure generative AI: given natural language input, it produces structured output that drives deterministic execution.

- Stage 4 — Memory-Augmented Context (GenAI + RAG pattern) After each command, the LLM extracts preferences from the interaction ("user prefers Arial font", "user always uses bold headers") and stores them in local JSON. On the next command, these facts are retrieved by keyword similarity and injected into the LLM prompt. This is a lightweight Retrieval-Augmented Generation pattern — the same architecture powering enterprise AI assistants — implemented without a vector database using simple keyword overlap scoring.

- Stage 5 — Neural Text-to-Speech (GenAI) Microsoft Edge's neural TTS voices (Jenny Neural for English, Swara Neural for Hindi) generate natural-sounding audio confirmations and destructive action warnings. These are transformer-based vocoder models streaming audio chunk-by-chunk for low latency.

**What makes this GenAI, not just automation**
Traditional Excel automation (macros, VBA, Power Automate) requires the user to know exact commands in advance and configure them explicitly. OFFICE-NATOR is different:

**Natural language understanding** — "column thoda bada karo" (make the column a bit wider) maps to a specific autofit sequence through LLM reasoning, not pattern matching
**Ambiguity resolution** — when the user says something unclear, the LLM interprets intent in context rather than failing with an error
**Personalization through memory** — the system learns individual habits over time and adapts its behavior, a capability unique to generative AI systems
**Multi-language generalization **— the same model handles variations in phrasing, mixed Hindi-English (Hinglish), and informal speech patterns without explicit programming

**The key architectural insight**
The project deliberately keeps GenAI in the reasoning layer only and uses deterministic code for execution. The LLM never invents keyboard shortcuts — it only picks from 129 pre-verified actions. This is a deliberate design choice that makes the system reliable enough for real work: GenAI for understanding, deterministic code for doing. This is the same principle behind function-calling in GPT-4 and tool-use in Claude — grounding generative outputs in verified, safe actions.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Machine Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Machine%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Deep Learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/Deep%20Learning-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today's fast-paced world, many serious health conditions such as heart disease, diabetes, obesity, sleep disorders, and mental health issues often develop silently over time due to unhealthy lifestyle habits, limited health awareness, and a lack of timely intervention. While numerous health applications can track basic health metrics, very few help individuals understand their overall health risks and provide clear, personalized guidance on how to improve their well-being.

PreventAI was developed to bridge this gap. It is an AI-powered preventive healthcare platform that brings together multiple health risk prediction models into a single, user-friendly system. Instead of simply predicting potential health conditions, PreventAI explains the underlying factors contributing to those risks, enabling users to gain meaningful insights into their health.

The platform goes beyond risk assessment by providing personalized workout recommendations, tailored diet plans, health improvement simulations, and structured wellness roadmaps based on an individual's lifestyle and goals. By transforming complex health data into practical and actionable recommendations, PreventAI encourages proactive healthcare, helping users make informed decisions, adopt healthier habits, and reduce the risk of developing chronic diseases in the future.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building PreventAI involved several technical and design challenges that required careful problem-solving and iterative improvements.

Dataset Integration: Combining multiple healthcare datasets from different sources was challenging because each dataset had different features, formats, and target variables. Significant preprocessing and feature engineering were required to make them suitable for model training.

Data Quality Issues: Several datasets contained missing values, inconsistent labels, imbalanced classes, and categorical features that required cleaning, encoding, and transformation before training reliable machine learning models.

Model Performance Optimization: Achieving good prediction performance across all five health domains required experimenting with different preprocessing techniques, algorithms, and evaluation methods while avoiding overfitting.

Multi-Model Integration: Integrating separate models for heart disease, diabetes, obesity, sleep disorders, and mental health into a single platform required designing a workflow that could generate consistent and meaningful outputs for users.

Explainability and User Trust: A key challenge was ensuring that predictions were not presented as black-box outputs. The system needed to explain why a particular risk was predicted and identify the factors contributing to that prediction.

Personalized Recommendation Generation: Converting model predictions into actionable workout plans, diet recommendations, health insights, and wellness roadmaps required developing additional logic beyond traditional machine learning workflows.

User Experience and Interface Design: Creating a healthcare platform that was both informative and visually appealing required multiple iterations of the website design, dashboard structure, and information presentation.

End-to-End System Integration: Bringing together machine learning models, recommendation engines, simulation logic, report generation, and the web interface into a unified application was one of the most challenging aspects of the project.

Despite these challenges, overcoming them helped transform PreventAI from a collection of individual machine learning models into a comprehensive preventive healthcare platform capable of delivering meaningful and personalized health guidance.

**Gen AI&ML**

PreventAI uses Machine Learning + Generative AI together for healthcare prediction and guidance.

ML models analyze user data (age, diet, activity, vitals) to predict disease risks like diabetes, heart disease, etc.
GenAI converts these predictions into simple explanations and personalized health advice, acting like a virtual health assistant.

In short:
ML predicts risk, GenAI explains it and gives lifestyle recommendations.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/impact-of-lookback-window-size-on-lstmbased-stock-price-prediction-da70) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/abdulsamadcrafts-alt/Stock-Prediction-Research-Model) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3yZLlhMhhOk) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3yZLlhMhhOk) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-HackPrix%20Season%203-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hackprix-2026.devfolio.co)

> stocks

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Long short-term memory (LSTM)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Long%20short--term%20memory%20(LSTM)-333333?style=flat-square) ![Keras RNN](https://img.shields.io/badge/Keras%20RNN-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

This project presents a deep learning-based approach to stock price prediction using a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), specifically an LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) model. The model is trained on historical stock data for companies such as Google and Apple, using features like Open, High, Low, Close, and Volume, with a primary focus on the Open price for time-series forecasting.

A key aspect of the project is the analysis of the lookback window (PAST_DAYS), which defines how many previous days of stock data are used to predict the next value. Experiments were conducted with different window sizes including 30, 60, 90, 120, and 150 days to evaluate their impact on model performance.

The results show that a 30-day lookback window produced the most accurate predictions, while increasing the window size led to reduced performance. This suggests that shorter-term dependencies are more effective for capturing stock market patterns in this dataset, as longer sequences may introduce noise and reduce model focus on recent trends.

Overall, the project demonstrates how LSTM networks can be used for financial time-series forecasting and highlights the importance of selecting an optimal input sequence length for improving predictive accuracy.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges was understanding how the lookback window (PAST_DAYS) affects model performance. Choosing the right number of past days was not straightforward, and different values like 30, 60, 90, 120, and 150 gave noticeably different results. It took multiple experiments to realize that longer sequences don’t always improve accuracy.

Another challenge was overfitting, since the LSTM model is quite powerful and can easily memorize patterns in the training data. I had to use dropout layers to reduce this issue and make the model generalize better.

A further difficulty was handling time-series data formatting, especially converting raw stock prices into supervised learning sequences. Creating the correct input shape for LSTM (3D structure: samples, timesteps, features) required careful reshaping.

I also faced issues with feature scaling and inverse transformation, because predictions were normalized during training and had to be properly converted back to real stock prices for evaluation and plotting.

Finally, interpreting the results was challenging since stock prices are highly volatile and influenced by external factors not included in the dataset, which limits prediction accuracy.

**Gen AI&ML**

This project is a deep learning-based stock price prediction system built using an LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) neural network. It analyzes historical stock market data to predict future stock prices based on past trends.

The model is trained on datasets from Google and Apple and uses time-series forecasting techniques, where previous days’ stock prices are used as input to predict the next value. A key part of this project is experimenting with different lookback windows (30, 60, 90, 120, and 150 days) to study how the amount of historical data affects prediction accuracy.

The results show that shorter lookback windows (especially 30 days) perform better, highlighting the importance of recent market trends in financial prediction.

Overall, this project demonstrates the application of deep learning to real-world financial data and explores how sequence length impacts model performance in time-series forecasting.

> Verified Actions. Trusted Impact.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![MetaMask](https://img.shields.io/badge/MetaMask-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs)](https://img.shields.io/badge/Zero--Knowledge%20Proofs%20(ZKPs)-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

GreenChain Credits is a blockchain-powered platform that transforms verified real-world environmental actions—such as tree planting, solar installations, EV adoption, and recycling—into tradable carbon credit NFTs. Using Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs), evidence verification, and blockchain transparency, the platform prevents duplicate claims and fraud while ensuring trust and traceability.

Users submit proof of their eco-friendly actions, which are validated and converted into carbon credits. These credits can then be bought by companies and organizations seeking to offset their carbon emissions and meet ESG goals. Every credit has a transparent audit trail, and once used, it can be permanently retired on-chain to prove environmental impact.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Verifying Real-World Environmental Actions

One of the biggest challenges was ensuring that users cannot claim carbon credits for fake or duplicated eco-actions. We had to design a verification pipeline using evidence uploads, hashing, location validation, and Zero-Knowledge Proofs to make the system more trustworthy.

2. Preventing Double Counting

Carbon markets often suffer from the same environmental action being claimed multiple times. We addressed this by introducing unique identifiers, evidence hashing, and ZK-based nullifiers to ensure each action can only generate credits once.

3. Bridging Physical Actions with Blockchain

Blockchains can only verify on-chain data, but environmental actions happen in the real world. Designing a secure bridge between off-chain evidence and on-chain carbon credits was a major architectural challenge.

4. Storage Architecture Decisions

We explored decentralized storage solutions such as IPFS/NFT.Storage and Pinata but encountered API changes, authentication issues, and integration complexity. Balancing decentralization with development speed led us to evaluate hybrid storage approaches.

5. Smart Contract Design

Designing contracts that securely mint, transfer, and retire carbon credits while maintaining transparency and preventing fraud required careful planning of data structures and validation flows.

**Blockchain**

GreenChain leverages blockchain to create transparent, fraud-resistant carbon credits. By tokenizing verified environmental actions as NFTs and recording their entire lifecycle on-chain, we enable secure ownership, trading, and retirement of carbon credits while eliminating double counting and increasing trust in climate action.

> Decentralized Identity for a Trustless World.

![Solidity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Solidity-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

In today's digital world, users must repeatedly share sensitive personal information with different organizations for verification purposes. Traditional identity systems are centralized, meaning governments, companies, and institutions store large amounts of personal data in their databases. This creates several challenges:

**Data Breaches:** Centralized databases are attractive targets for hackers, leading to identity theft and privacy violations.

**Lack of User Control:** Individuals have little control over how their personal information is stored, shared, or used.

**Repeated Verification Processes: **Users must repeatedly complete KYC (Know Your Customer) and identity verification procedures for banks, universities, employers, and online services.

**Privacy Concerns:** Many services require more information than necessary. For example, proving you are over 18 often requires revealing your full date of birth.

**Difficulty Verifying Credentials:** Employers and institutions often struggle to quickly verify the authenticity of certificates, degrees, and professional credentials.

Cross-Platform Identity Fragmentation: Users maintain multiple identities across different platforms, resulting in inefficiency and inconsistent verification processes.

**Challenges we ran into**

Challenges I Ran Into

- Implementing Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) for privacy-preserving authentication was one of the most technically challenging aspects of the project due to the complexity of proof generation and verification.

- Building a multi-chain DID resolution system across Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Arbitrum required handling different blockchain networks and maintaining consistent identity resolution. 

- Designing a secure Verifiable Credential framework while balancing privacy, authenticity, and efficient data storage was a significant challenge.

- Ensuring reliable wallet-based identity ownership verification and preventing unauthorized modifications to decentralized identities required careful security considerations.

- Managing synchronization between on-chain blockchain records and off-chain IPFS storage added complexity to maintaining data consistency and integrity.

- Creating a user-friendly experience for complex Web3 concepts such as DIDs, credentials, wallets, and ZKPs without overwhelming users was another major challenge.

**Blockchain**

This project directly aligns with the Decentralized Identity and Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) track by providing a blockchain-based identity system where users own and control their digital identities. It leverages W3C Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs), Verifiable Credentials, and Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) to enable secure, privacy-preserving, and trustless identity verification across multiple blockchain networks. This eliminates reliance on centralized authorities while enhancing privacy, security, and interoperability in Web3 ecosystems.

### Fortress Wallet
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/fortress-wallet-d7b3) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://fortress-wallet.gitbook.io/fortress-wallet-docs) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Locus'%20Paygentic%20Hackathon%20--%20#4-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://paygentic-week4.devfolio.co)

> The Active Firewall for Web3

![Cryptography](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cryptography-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebAssembly](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebAssembly-333333?style=flat-square) ![Web3](https://img.shields.io/badge/Web3-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The Problem: As retail participation surges in high-velocity Web3 markets, users are constantly exposed to wallet drainers, phishing, and malicious smart contracts. Traditional non-custodial wallets act merely as passive gateways, offering zero active protection during the actual transaction phase. This leaves retail users highly vulnerable to "blind signing" and complete fund loss.

The Solution: Fortress Wallet
Fortress is a next-generation non-custodial wallet built entirely on zero-trust architecture. We bring enterprise-grade Fintech security to the everyday retail user by functioning as an active firewall rather than just a key vault.

Active WASM Firewall: A lightweight WebAssembly (WASM) security layer that pre-simulates and verifies transactions to block malicious contract interactions before they are signed, adding zero noticeable latency.

Transaction-Level 2FA: A strict secondary verification layer that prevents unauthorized fund access, even if the primary device environment is compromised.

High-Entropy Recovery: Pioneering a highly secure 34/35-word Sanskrit recovery phrase system, drastically increasing cryptographic entropy to neutralize standard dictionary and brute-force attacks.

Fortress Wallet allows users to trade in massive liquidity pools safely, knowing their infrastructure is actively defending their assets.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the most significant hurdles was engineering the active firewall and transaction-level 2FA without sacrificing execution speed. In high-liquidity, high-speed environments, adding even a fraction of a second of latency destroys the user experience and can cost users money on slippage.

How I overcame it: I aggressively optimized the security layer by compiling the core threat-detection and transaction-simulation logic into WebAssembly (WASM). This allowed the wallet to run complex, real-time security heuristics at near-native speeds directly on the client side, ensuring zero-trust security without the lag.

Additionally, extending standard wallet protocols to support the 34/35-word Sanskrit recovery phrases presented a unique cryptographic challenge. Standard BIP-39 libraries are rigid. I had to architect a custom mapping for the entropy generation and derivation paths to ensure absolute security and seamless wallet recovery, while strictly maintaining the non-custodial integrity of the platform.

**Using LocusFounder to Build a Business!**

How Fortress Wallet integrates with LocusFounder:
While Fortress Wallet handles the bare-metal Web3 security (WASM active firewall, 34/35-word Sanskrit recovery, and transaction-level 2FA), we are utilizing LocusFounder to autonomously build and operate our Go-To-Market (GTM) infrastructure.

We are using LocusFounder to instantly spin up our consumer-facing storefront, generate conversion-optimized copy explaining our complex zero-trust architecture to retail users, and autonomously manage our lead-generation and ad campaigns across Google and Meta. By letting LocusFounder handle the entire business operation and customer acquisition funnel, it frees me up as a solo founder to focus 100% of my time on engineering the cryptographic infrastructure and Solana Mobile Stack integration.

Kartikay Sharma
